statement: A stock company must select a director to represent the company (대표이사, representative director) by resolution of the board of directors, unless the articles of incorporation provide for selection at a general meeting of shareholders (Commercial Act Article 389(1)); joint representative directors may be provided for (Article 389(2)), and the representative director’s name, resident registration number and address are registered matters of the incorporation registration (Article 317(2)9).
caveat: Small companies with capital under KRW 1 billion may run with one or two directors under Article 383, which reshapes the board mechanics this rule assumes; representative-director changes are themselves registrable changes on the two-week clock.
